name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.3 degrees south of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 9 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-09-29, at wavelengths from 1.10 to 4.41 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
